ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Corporate training, Needs analysis and later stages need Needs summary, Delegate count and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Corporate_training", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry qualified", 1, "Needs analysis", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Stakeholder review", 4, "Terms agreed", 5, "Booked", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Needs_summary__c), ISBLANK(Delegate_count__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Needs summary, Delegate count and Next step date before moving to Needs analysis.
